name: Ningbo Sanxing Medical Electric Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Sanxing Medical Electric Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells power distribution in China and internationally. The company offers prepaid. ANSI, classical, photovoltaic, and smart meters; data concentrator units, CIUS, and modules; and DC and AC chargers. It also provides AMI and smart prepayment solutions under the SanPlat name; Wi-SUN solution comprising smart meters, communication modules, gateways, repeaters, and network management systems; and FDM solutions. In addition, the company offers charging station and dynamic load balance solutions. Further, it provides financial leasing and consulting services, as well as medical services.
